name: Set 4: The Biltong & Brandy Classic
description: Currie Cup, Classic Rock, Kitchen Secrets & World Wonders

questions.q: In the game of snooker or pool, what color is the cue ball?
questions.round: Round 1 · Taproom Warm-Up & General Quizzing
questions.fact: The cue ball is white.

questions.q: How many players are on the field for one team in a standard association football (soccer) match?
questions.round: Round 1 · Taproom Warm-Up & General Quizzing
questions.fact: 10 outfield players plus 1 goalkeeper.

questions.q: What spirit is traditionally the base of a classic Mojito cocktail?
questions.round: Round 1 · Taproom Warm-Up & General Quizzing
questions.fact: White rum muddled with fresh mint, lime juice, sugar, and club soda.

questions.q: How many degrees are there in a standard right angle?
questions.round: Round 1 · Taproom Warm-Up & General Quizzing
questions.fact: A right angle is exactly 90 degrees.

questions.q: Which fast food chain is famous for the catchphrase 'Finger Lickin' Good'?
questions.round: Round 1 · Taproom Warm-Up & General Quizzing
questions.fact: Kentucky Fried Chicken, founded by Colonel Harland Sanders.

questions.q: What is the hardest natural substance known on Earth?
questions.round: Round 1 · Taproom Warm-Up & General Quizzing
questions.fact: Diamond rates 10 on the Mohs scale of mineral hardness.

questions.q: What is the term for a score of one under par on a golf hole?
questions.round: Round 1 · Taproom Warm-Up & General Quizzing
questions.fact: One under par = Birdie. Two under par = Eagle.

questions.q: What popular South African maize meal porridge is a mandatory staple at a braai?
questions.round: Round 1 · Taproom Warm-Up & General Quizzing
questions.fact: Mieliepap: crumbly stywepap or smooth slappap served with sheba tomato relish.

questions.q: What is the capital city of Italy?
questions.round: Round 1 · Taproom Warm-Up & General Quizzing
questions.fact: Rome: The Eternal City.

questions.q: In bowling, what term is used when you knock down all 10 pins with your first roll?
questions.round: Round 1 · Taproom Warm-Up & General Quizzing
questions.fact: Marked as an 'X' on the scoreboard.

questions.q: What prestigious gold trophy has been awarded to the champions of South African provincial rugby since 1892?
questions.round: Round 2 · Super Rugby, Currie Cup & Ashes Clashes
questions.fact: Donated by Sir Donald Currie in 1889 to the touring British Isles team.

questions.q: Which cricket ground in Centurion, Pretoria is famous for its grass banks and Boxing Day test matches?
questions.round: Round 2 · Super Rugby, Currie Cup & Ashes Clashes
questions.fact: SuperSport Park Centurion, fortress of the Titans.

questions.q: Which South African rugby legend was named IRB International Player of the Year in 2004?
questions.round: Round 2 · Super Rugby, Currie Cup & Ashes Clashes
questions.fact: Schalk Burger won IRB World Player of the Year in 2004 for his incredible loose forward play.

questions.q: In cricket, how many wickets must a bowler take on consecutive deliveries to achieve a 'hat-trick'?
questions.round: Round 2 · Super Rugby, Currie Cup & Ashes Clashes
questions.fact: Three wickets on three consecutive balls.

questions.q: Which South African flyhalf scored all of South Africa's 15 points in the 2007 Rugby World Cup final in Paris?
questions.round: Round 2 · Super Rugby, Currie Cup & Ashes Clashes
questions.fact: Percy Montgomery kicked 4 penalties (12 pts) and Francois Steyn slotted a 50m penalty (3 pts).

questions.q: What is the famous nickname of the South African national netball team?
questions.round: Round 2 · Super Rugby, Currie Cup & Ashes Clashes
questions.fact: The SPAR Proteas represent South Africa in international netball.

questions.q: Which South African winger set the joint record for the most tries scored in Rugby World Cup history (15 tries, tied with Jonah Lomu)?
questions.round: Round 2 · Super Rugby, Currie Cup & Ashes Clashes
questions.fact: Habana scored 8 tries in 2007, 2 in 2011, and 5 in 2015.

questions.q: Which test cricket ground in Port Elizabeth (Gqeberha) is world-famous for its brass band playing in the stands?
questions.round: Round 2 · Super Rugby, Currie Cup & Ashes Clashes
questions.fact: The St George's Park Brass Band has entertained test crowds for decades.

questions.q: What is the nickname of the national men's soccer team of South Africa?
questions.round: Round 2 · Super Rugby, Currie Cup & Ashes Clashes
questions.fact: 'The Boys, The Boys' in Zulu.

questions.q: Which Formula One team did South African driver Jody Scheckter drive for when he won the F1 World Championship in 1979?
questions.round: Round 2 · Super Rugby, Currie Cup & Ashes Clashes
questions.fact: Scheckter won the 1979 Drivers' Championship driving the Ferrari 312T4.

questions.q: Which American rock band had a massive global hit in 1982 with the song 'Africa'?
questions.round: Round 3 · Radio Hits, One-Hit Wonders & Golden Oldies
questions.fact: 'I bless the rains down in Africa...' released on the Toto IV album.

questions.q: Who sang the iconic 1984 pop anthem 'Summer of '69'?
questions.round: Round 3 · Radio Hits, One-Hit Wonders & Golden Oldies
questions.fact: Canadian rocker Bryan Adams from his album Reckless.

questions.q: What legendary British singer and songwriter was born Farrokh Bulsara in Zanzibar?
questions.round: Round 3 · Radio Hits, One-Hit Wonders & Golden Oldies
questions.fact: Freddie Mercury of Queen, born in Stone Town, Zanzibar in 1946.

questions.q: Which South African music legend was affectionately known as 'The White Zulu' and co-founded the bands Juluka and Savuka?
questions.round: Round 3 · Radio Hits, One-Hit Wonders & Golden Oldies
questions.fact: Johnny Clegg OBE, creator of 'Asimbonanga' and 'Scatterlings of Africa'.

questions.q: Which Swedish pop group won the Eurovision Song Contest in 1974 with the song 'Waterloo'?
questions.round: Round 3 · Radio Hits, One-Hit Wonders & Golden Oldies
questions.fact: Agnetha, Björn, Benny, and Anni-Frid.

questions.q: In the 1980 hit song 'Don't Stop Believin'', which American band tells the story of a small-town girl and a city boy?
questions.round: Round 3 · Radio Hits, One-Hit Wonders & Golden Oldies
questions.fact: Featuring Steve Perry's soaring lead vocals.

questions.q: What was the title of South African singer Kurt Darren's mega-hit Afrikaans party anthem released in 2002 that had everyone doing the line-dance?
questions.round: Round 3 · Radio Hits, One-Hit Wonders & Golden Oldies
questions.fact: 'Meisie Meisie' became an absolute countrywide craze at weddings and bars.

questions.q: Which British band released the critically acclaimed 1997 album OK Computer featuring 'Karma Police'?
questions.round: Round 3 · Radio Hits, One-Hit Wonders & Golden Oldies
questions.fact: Fronted by Thom Yorke.

questions.q: Which American rock icon was known as 'The Boss' and released the 1984 smash hit album Born in the U.S.A.?
questions.round: Round 3 · Radio Hits, One-Hit Wonders & Golden Oldies
questions.fact: Bruce Springsteen and the E Street Band.

questions.q: What hit 1991 Metallica song begins with James Hetfield whispering 'Say your prayers, little one'?
questions.round: Round 3 · Radio Hits, One-Hit Wonders & Golden Oldies
questions.fact: Lead single from Metallica's legendary self-titled 'Black Album'.

questions.q: What is the primary agricultural grain used to produce traditional single malt Scotch whisky?
questions.round: Round 4 · Bar Snacks, Spirits & Kitchen Myths
questions.fact: By law, single malt Scotch must be made exclusively from 100% malted barley.

questions.q: Which famous South African brandy has an export gold medal label depicting a clock face set to 8:20?
questions.round: Round 4 · Bar Snacks, Spirits & Kitchen Myths
questions.fact: Klipdrift Export: 'Met eish, ja!' The clock on the label is famously set at 8:20.

questions.q: What plant does authentic Tequila have to be distilled from?
questions.round: Round 4 · Bar Snacks, Spirits & Kitchen Myths
questions.fact: Specifically Blue Weber Agave in the designated state of Jalisco, Mexico.

questions.q: Which famous street-food loaf stuffed with hot slap chips, polony or steak, and sauce originated in Cape Town's Athlone area?
questions.round: Round 4 · Bar Snacks, Spirits & Kitchen Myths
questions.fact: The Gatsby: a giant foot-long crusty roll stuffed with chips and meat, built to share.

questions.q: What Durban Indian street-food delicacy consists of a hollowed-out quarter loaf of white bread filled with spicy curry?
questions.round: Round 4 · Bar Snacks, Spirits & Kitchen Myths
questions.fact: Originated in Durban in the 1940s among Indian migrant laborers.

questions.q: In South Africa, what is the colloquial term for small, thin, dry strips of biltong often flavored with chili?
questions.round: Round 4 · Bar Snacks, Spirits & Kitchen Myths
questions.fact: Snapsticks: thin dried strips that snap when bent.

questions.q: What is the botanical herb that gives absinthe and ouzo their distinctive aniseed / licorice flavor?
questions.round: Round 4 · Bar Snacks, Spirits & Kitchen Myths
questions.fact: Aniseed contains anethole, which turns cloudy (the louche effect) when water is added.

questions.q: What type of pastry is used to create traditional South African baked custard melktert (milk tart)?
questions.round: Round 4 · Bar Snacks, Spirits & Kitchen Myths
questions.fact: Dusting ground cinnamon on top of the baked custard is non-negotiable!

questions.q: Which South African craft gin distillery in the Karoo town of Richmond is famous for distilling botanicals from indigenous fynbos and wild juniper?
questions.round: Round 4 · Bar Snacks, Spirits & Kitchen Myths
questions.fact: Inverroche pioneered the use of Cape fynbos in craft gin production.

questions.q: What is the name of the German beer purity law dating back to 1516 that limited beer ingredients to water, barley, and hops?
questions.round: Round 4 · Bar Snacks, Spirits & Kitchen Myths
questions.fact: The Bavarian Reinheitsgebot of 1516.

questions.q: What is the name of the colossal green canyon along Mpumalanga's Panorama Route, recognized as the third largest canyon on Earth?
questions.round: Round 5 · Famous Landmarks, Oceans & Road Trips
questions.fact: Famous for the Three Rondavels and God's Window.

questions.q: What ocean lies directly to the east of South Africa, carrying the warm Agulhas Current down the coastline?
questions.round: Round 5 · Famous Landmarks, Oceans & Road Trips
questions.fact: The warm Indian Ocean washes the KwaZulu-Natal and Eastern Cape shores.

questions.q: Which massive meteorite impact crater, located near Parys in the Free State, is the oldest and largest verified impact crater on Earth?
questions.round: Round 5 · Famous Landmarks, Oceans & Road Trips
questions.fact: A UNESCO World Heritage Site formed over 2 billion years ago.

questions.q: What is the official judicial capital of South Africa, where the Supreme Court of Appeal is located?
questions.round: Round 5 · Famous Landmarks, Oceans & Road Trips
questions.fact: Bloemfontein (Judicial), Pretoria (Administrative), Cape Town (Legislative).

questions.q: What is the largest island in the world that is not a continent?
questions.round: Round 5 · Famous Landmarks, Oceans & Road Trips
questions.fact: Greenland covers over 2.1 million square kilometers.

questions.q: Which mountain range forms the border between France and Spain?
questions.round: Round 5 · Famous Landmarks, Oceans & Road Trips
questions.fact: The Pyrenees stretch between the Bay of Biscay and the Mediterranean Sea.

questions.q: What famous island in Table Bay was used as a maximum-security prison where Nelson Mandela spent 18 of his 27 years in captivity?
questions.round: Round 5 · Famous Landmarks, Oceans & Road Trips
questions.fact: 'Robben' means seals in Dutch. Now a UNESCO World Heritage site.

questions.q: Which South African province is the largest in geographic land area?
questions.round: Round 5 · Famous Landmarks, Oceans & Road Trips
questions.fact: The Northern Cape accounts for nearly 31% of South Africa's total land area.

questions.q: What is the capital city of Japan?
questions.round: Round 5 · Famous Landmarks, Oceans & Road Trips
questions.fact: Tokyo is the world's most populous metropolitan area.

questions.q: What major dam on the Orange River is the largest reservoir dam in South Africa by water volume?
questions.round: Round 5 · Famous Landmarks, Oceans & Road Trips
questions.fact: Formerly the Hendrik Verwoerd Dam, holding over 5.3 billion cubic meters of water.

questions.q: In what calendar year did the Vredefort asteroid hit Earth?
questions.round: Sudden-Death Tie-Breakers
questions.fact: Estimated at 2.023 billion years ago.

questions.q: How many total test matches did Percy Montgomery play for the Springboks?
questions.round: Sudden-Death Tie-Breakers
questions.fact: Montgomery was the first Springbok in history to reach 100 test caps.

questions.q: What is the maximum water capacity of Gariep Dam in billions of cubic meters?
questions.round: Sudden-Death Tie-Breakers
questions.fact: Gariep Dam holds approximately 5.34 billion cubic meters.
